messages:
Maya (CS): Quick heads-up — collecting 1–2 line feature asks and top pain points from onboarding accounts today. Can folks drop top 3 items per account in this thread by EOD? Trying to build a compact prioritized intake for the product weekly sync. If you can, add a short note on impact (downtime, blockers, revenue or usage).

Diego (CS): Starting with HelioHealth — 1) latency on long prompts (esp. multi-file transcripts) causing retries, 2) want per-route cost breakdown in console, 3) need ability to pin model version per-route for canaries. Impact: retries = 3% request failures.

Sam (PM): Nice. Can we use a one-line format so I can paste into the triage sheet? Like: `Account — Ask — Why it matters (1 sentence)`

Maya (CS): Yes. I'll paste a tiny template below.

Maya (CS): ```Account,Ask,Impact
HelioHealth,lower-latency-long-seq-path,retries up 3% on long transcripts
SummitHealth,per-route-cost-breakdown,finance needs to reconcile monthly invoice
ParkCo,pin-model-version-per-route,want stable canary->prod rollout```

Jon (Eng): Noted re: long-seq path — we have a perf experiment in branch `kv-cache-opt-v2` that might help. I'll flag for a canary test if CS can surface a small prompt set.

Diego (CS): SummitHealth — also asked for better webhook retry visibility (they lost 1 sync). Add that as follow-up.

Aisha (Product Ops): I'll take these and map to the intake sheet. Plan: collect by EOD, then run quick scoring (frequency x impact) and tag top 5 for weekly dev sync. Who can own prompt set for HelioHealth?

Diego (CS): I can assemble a 10-prompt set and mark which prompts fail. ETA tomorrow morning.

Sam (PM): For prioritization: can we add `Regulatory risk` and `Renewal signal` flags when relevant? Those should bump priority.

Maya (CS): Added — please prefix asks with `[RR]` or `[Renewal]` if applicable. Example: `[Renewal] ParkCo — pin-model-version-per-route — prevents rollout regressions for their critical feature`.

cs-bot: Reminder sent: customer feedback capture form to 5 accounts (HelioHealth, SummitHealth, ParkCo, BrightSpark, ClearHarbor). Link: https://redwood.app/feedback-form

Aisha (Product Ops): I'll consolidate into `docs/feedback-intake/this-week.csv` and post a quick summary before the 10am sync. If anyone has urgent renewal flags please DM me directly. :thumbsup:
